lessons.title: Singing Tubes and Bottles: Air Columns Resonate
lessons.focus: Blow across bottles; straw oboe with cut reed; resonance when tube length fits the wave.
lessons.advanced: For a tube closed at one end, λ≈4L: predict the note of a 25 cm tube and test it.

lessons.title: Build: Pan Pipes from Straws
lessons.focus: Cut straws to calculated lengths, plug one end, bind the raft; play a scale; compare with predictions.
lessons.advanced: Compute lengths for an 8-note scale from f∝1/L with your lowest note at 20 cm; list all eight.

lessons.title: Build: The Debe Telephone
lessons.focus: Two tins joined by taut string; sound rides the string; test taut vs slack, long vs short, string vs wire.
lessons.advanced: Explain energy transmission along the string; why does a loose string kill the call?

lessons.title: Loudness: Amplitude and the Decibel Idea
lessons.focus: Big vibration = loud; logarithmic teaser (10× energy = +10 dB); posho mill and ear safety; quiet and loud spots mapped.
lessons.advanced: Posho mill 100 dB vs conversation 60 dB: how many times more sound energy? Show the log reasoning.

lessons.title: Echoes and Sonar: Sound as a Ruler
lessons.focus: Echo ranging revisited; bats and fishermen's fish-finders; compute distances from echo times.
lessons.advanced: Echo returns in 0.30 s: distance? Then: design an echo depth-sounder for a dugout canoe.

lessons.title: Soaking Up Sound: Thatch, Soft Things and Quiet Rooms
lessons.focus: Clap in a bare hall vs grass-thatched space; soft surfaces absorb, hard reflect; classroom acoustics fixes.
lessons.advanced: Propose three low-cost acoustic fixes for a noisy classroom and the physics behind each.

lessons.title: Noise Pollution in Our Town
lessons.focus: Map loud/quiet zones around school and market; health effects; propose a community noise plan.
lessons.advanced: Estimate distance doubling drop (≈ −6 dB in open air): how far must a 100 dB speaker be to reach 70 dB?

lessons.title: The Physics of Kenyan Instruments
lessons.focus: Survey: ngoma, kayamba shaker, orutu, litungu, flutes; classify by vibrating part (string/membrane/air); invite a local player.
lessons.advanced: Write the physics profile of one instrument: vibrator, resonator, pitch control, amplification.

lessons.title: Project: The Class Orchestra
lessons.focus: Assemble bottle xylophones, one-strings, pan pipes, drums; compose and perform a piece; program notes include the physics.
lessons.advanced: Write program notes explaining the pitch physics of your instrument section.

lessons.title: Unit Review: Sound Fair
lessons.focus: Instrument petting zoo, echo game, telephone race; unit quiz.
lessons.advanced: Quiz-writer task: one question linking f=1/L to a real instrument, with mark scheme.
